name: agy-orch
description: Call any CLI agent you need from Antigravity (Codex by default) to review plans, catch bugs, and run scoped fixes while skipping trivial edits and rejecting overdesign.
author: Ziyan Lin
suggestedPrompts: Decide whether this change needs an external agent review.
Ask a second agent to review the current diff without editing files.
Delegate this bug fix in a separate worktree and limit edits to the affected files.
